ext_description.message: Filter YouTube/Twitch comments with local rules and an optional experimental AI filter for Japanese comments.

platform_hint_both.message: Applied to all streams and YouTube comments

platform_hint_youtube_live.message: Applied to YouTube Live / Premiere only

platform_hint_youtube_normal.message: Applied to YouTube normal comments only

error_duplicate_word.message: This word is already registered (including similar spellings)

ai_description.message: Run Saiji-Toxic-v2 inside the browser using WebGPU or WASM. Comments stay local; no Python server is needed. Initial model loading takes time.

ai_caveat.message: AI may misclassify comments. Comments may briefly appear before being hidden. AI results do not count toward automatic bans. Discrimination includes neutral political topics. Overall includes advice and other stream-specific topics.

ai_threshold_hint.message: Hide when a selected category reaches its threshold. Higher thresholds hide fewer comments.

ai_saved.message: Saved. Settings also apply to open pages.

ai_unavailable.message: Model initialization or inference failed. Try CPU (WASM).

ai_test_hint.message: Enable and save first, then enter text to inspect all ten scores.

ai_test_disabled.message: Enable and save the AI filter first.

ai_experimental.message: Experimental: the AI filter is designed for Japanese stream comments. Accuracy in other languages has not been evaluated. It can miss harmful comments or hide harmless ones.

ai_preparing.message: Preparing. Enable the AI filter and open a YouTube/Twitch tab.

ai_idle.message: Stopped: enable the AI filter and open a YouTube/Twitch tab.

ai_download.message: Download the model from Hugging Face when missing

ai_download_hint.message: Initial download: about 650 MB, cached in your browser. The model host receives connection metadata such as your IP address, but never comment text. Save after changing settings.

ai_lifecycle.message: Loads only when classification is needed. Closing all target tabs or disabling filtering releases the model from memory; the downloaded model stays cached.

ai_model_info.message: Saiji-Toxic-v2 / on-device browser inference, up to 128 tokens

ai_backend_hint.message: Initial setup needs time and memory. After changing the backend, save and check model readiness.

ai_preset_hint.message: The experimental preset hides comments when any of the first five categories reaches about 0.005039215. False positives and missed harmful comments remain. Save after changes.
